name: Security agent
role: Turns profiles, permission sets and sharing into database roles, column-level grants and row-level security. Also produces the credentials and integrations checklist: what must be re-issued and which systems call in.
done_when: Each profile and permission set is a role; field access is a column grant; sharing is a row-level policy
reviewer_checks: Read-only fields have no update grant
Sharing inherited from the parent where Salesforce does
Every integration and inbound caller has an owner, a new credential and a switch date
